profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I am a backend-focused engineer with 13 years experience and a background working in high throughput, complex systems and building for resiliency. I have a track record of comprehensive problem-solving, strong communication, and fostering healthy team culture

I am passionate about creating scalable, readable software on collaborative teams. I most love developing services in Elixir, with years of full-stack experience to draw on. My preferred tools also include GraphQL, effective documentation, React, goofy team games, and mentoring.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Making life a little bit easier for families. Ruby, Rails, APIs galore.
positions.insights: Ruby on Rails, Project Management and +1 skill

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Scaled and maintained tier 1 API Gateway (Elixir, GraphQL) serving 800k requests per minute. The gateway is backed by 150+ services across 30+ teams. Maintained 99.99%+ SLA.
- Collaborated on fault-tolerant system auditing thousands of GraphQL mutation per day. I drove the finished product across teams; reviewed and simplified implementation, found and fixed multiple missing audit cases, oversaw rollout, and monitored release.
- Worked cross-team to replace an API backing GraphQL fields serving thousands of requests per minute; this project reduced customer issue MTTR by 8 days (average) by removing team dependencies.
- Led team’s migration to AWS hosting in product-wide initiative, including:
high-level research and project management in a constantly evolving space, spanning 1.5 years to migrate 6+ critical Elixir and Java services,
redesigning NerdGraph’s caching layer (distributed Elixir to Redis/Elixir hybrid).

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Regularly consulted company-wide on GraphQL schema design, debugging issues across system layers, and incident resolution.
- Led project to merge two API key types (Kafka, GraphQL, Postgres); simplified internal storage, removed redundant customer API key type.
- Designed and executed solution to access the legacy REST API with new API keys, enabling our programmability tools to use 100+ new endpoints.
- Contribute key UI features (React) to help customers easily explore our API
- Reorganized, expanded, and added search functionality to internal docs
- Extracted and re-built multiple existing features out of a monolithic Rails application to modernized React SPAs backed by multiple APIs (REST, GraphQL).
- Pioneered the use of role-based authorization in New Relic’s flagship product; led a zero-error rollout as well as provided shared code helpers, documentation, and testing infrastructure used across all product teams.
- Created and pitched a plan for the future of multiple engineering teams adopted by engineering leadership

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Co-led significant pieces of a Rails upgrade (3.0 -> 3.2) in an application that served 85% of product traffic and was actively shared by 70+ engineers, with no downtime at upgrade.
- Extracted an admin tool used by 5+ departments into a Ruby service and backing API (REST), enabling critical role-based authorization not possible in the legacy application.
- Maintained and grew  third-party integrations including Marketo, Netsuite, and Salesforce.
- Worked on the design and implementation of the next generation of New Relic’s billing software using Angular, Ruby, and Sinatra

positions.title: Programmer/Fellow
positions.description: 10-week programming fellowship covering programming fundamentals using Python, Javascript, and HTML/CSS.

positions.title: Americorps Community Outreach Coordinator
positions.description: Led volunteer program with 30-plus volunteers/month; organized seasonal programs and classes reaching 200-plus low-income families. Pitched and led organizational projects and quarterly newsletter.
